description: Reconstruct the complete Chain of Reasoning for a governed session, agent, or time range. Returns every link — AI Brain state, deliberation steps, precedent cited, gate decisions, knowledge packs, merit assessments — in causal order with hash-chain verification. Use "summary" format for a quick overview, "full" for all links, "dag" for the causal graph, or "export" for an EU AI Act compliance artifact.

agent_id.description: Agent ID (required when scope = "agent"). Can be a user ID or model name.

end.description: End of time range (ISO 8601). Default: now.

format.description: Response format: "summary" = stats only, "full" = all links, "dag" = causal graph with edges, "export" = EU AI Act compliance artifact.

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return (default: 100, max: 500). Only applies to "full" format.

scope.description: What to query: "session" for a specific committee session, "agent" for an agent over time, "time_range" for all activity in a period.

session_id.description: Committee session ID (required when scope = "session"). Format: cs-{uuid}

start.description: Start of time range (ISO 8601). Default: 7 days ago.

name: chain_of_reasoning
